import subprocess, time, json
bins = ['O0','O1','O2','O3','Ofast']

    path = f'/app/benchmark_{b}'
    times = []
    for i in range(3):
        s = time.perf_counter()
        r = subprocess.run([path], capture_output=True, text=True)
        e = time.perf_counter()
        dt = e - s
        times.append(dt)
        print(f"{b} run {i+1}: {dt:.4f}s out={r.stdout.strip()[:60]} rc={r.returncode}", flush=True)

    print(f"{b} avg: {avg:.4f}s", flush=True)
baseline = avgs['O0']
metrics = {}
for lvl in ['O1','O2','O3','Ofast']:
    imp = (baseline - avgs[lvl]) / baseline * 100.0
    metrics[f'{lvl}_pct_improvement'] = imp
print(json.dumps(metrics, indent=2))
with open('/app/metrics.json','w') as f:
    json.dump(metrics, f, indent=2)
print('wrote /app/metrics.json')
